title: Re-importing a customer keeps all its representatives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Create a customer for this test with Service Labor set to sales rep A, Service Parts set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep C.
  • Have a contacts import file that contains the customer with its current details.
  • Open the contacts import in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.

Step 2:

  • Service Labor sales rep A, Service Parts sales rep B and Part Sales sales rep C are all still there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-N3: “Re-importing an existing customer through the contacts import never changes its representatives. Every field, including Service Parts and Part Sales, stays as it was. Before this change a re-import cleared the customer's representative.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
